subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should opaque Claude CLI and Codex app-server turns become `model.call` lifecycles with an observation-unit discriminator, or use a separate agent-turn/invoke-agent diagnostic while `model.call` remains request-scoped?
rationale: Both shapes are implementable, but they define the permanent public telemetry taxonomy, dashboard compatibility, and content-capture boundary; tests cannot determine maintainer intent.

options.title: Separate Turn Lifecycle
options.body: Keep `model.call` request-scoped and export opaque CLI turns through a distinct agent-turn or invoke-agent lifecycle with dedicated metrics and capture rules.

options.title: Approve Mixed Model Calls
options.body: Retain `observationUnit=turn`, but explicitly approve the compatibility break, document migration behavior, preserve or replace existing Codex dashboards, and define whether thinking content is allowed.

recommendation.title: Separate Turn Lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep `model.call` request-scoped and export opaque CLI turns through a distinct agent-turn or invoke-agent lifecycle with dedicated metrics and capture rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person closest to the Codex app-server lifecycle and surrounding runtime contract that the decision affects.
